channel.description: Only return canvases in this channel (channel id).

kind.description: Only return canvases of this kind. kind=component lists the component store.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

ordering.description: Sort order. -created_at (default) puts the newest canvases first. -updated_at puts the most recently changed canvases first.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on name and description — use to find store components by what they show.
